reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'new' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS new_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'expansion' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'contraction' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'churn' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS churn_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'reactivation' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_eur,
  SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS net_change_eur
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  AND e.event_type <> 'opening'
  AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)

WITH wide AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025 with a movement
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'new' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS new_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'expansion' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'contraction' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'churn' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS churn_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 'reactivation' THEN e.mrr_delta_local ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
    AND e.event_type <> 'opening'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT month, new_eur, expansion_eur, contraction_eur, churn_eur, reactivation_eur,
  new_eur + expansion_eur + contraction_eur + churn_eur + reactivation_eur AS net_change_eur
FROM wide
